% ==================== PROJECTS ====================
\section*{Projects}

% PROJECT 1
\textbf{Smart Environmental Monitoring System} \,|\, Individual project \,|\, \faGithub\ \href{https://github.com/SangNguyen-232/IoT-Env-Monitor}{GitHub Repo} \hfill \textit{Jul 2026 -- Nov 2026} \\
\textbf{Stack:} ESP32-S3, C/C++, FreeRTOS, TFLite Micro, Python, Express, PostgreSQL, Docker, Cloudflare Tunnel
\begin{itemize}
    \item Built ESP32-S3 firmware with seven FreeRTOS tasks: DHT20 sampling over I2C every 5\,s, a $16\times2$ LCD with LED indicators, and soil-moisture sampling on a separate ADC channel.
    \item Integrated a 5,536-byte INT8 TFLite Micro model (4\,KiB arena) forecasting the OFF/HOLD/ON band 30\,s ahead; trained and evaluated on simulated data, scoring 87.28\% on held-out episodes in desktop tests.
    \item Designed relay control across AUTO, SHADOW, AI and MANUAL modes with hysteresis, 10\,s minimum dwell and fail-safe shutoff on invalid or stale readings; ran inference outside the mutex and discarded outdated results.
    \item Developed and tested on an Ubuntu VM; deployed a Dockerized Express/PostgreSQL API through Cloudflare Tunnel and Workers VPC with no inbound ports, while a LAN WebSocket dashboard keeps fan control working offline.
\end{itemize}
